 def __init__(self,s):

 def ik(self,p,R,q=None,n=100):
  s,m,d=self.s,self.m,self.k
  if q is None:q=s.data.qpos[s._jq].copy()
  else:q=q.copy()
  jp=np.zeros((3,m.nv));jr=jp.copy()
  for _ in range(n):
   d.qpos[s._jq]=q;mujoco.mj_forward(m,d)
   err=np.r_[p-d.xpos[self.bid],Rot.from_matrix(R@d.xmat[self.bid].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(err)<1e-6:break

   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+0.00001*np.eye(6),err)
   q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7]+dq*min(1,.15/(np.max(abs(dq))+1e-9)),s.lower[:7]+.001,s.upper[:7]-.001)
  return q
 def move(self,q,N=120):
  ini=self.s.targets.copy()
  for t in range(N):
   a=(t+1)/N;a=a*a*(3-2*a);self.s.step(ini*(1-a)+q*a)
 def pose(self,p,R,hand=None,N=120):
  q=self.ik(p,R)
  if hand is not None:q[7:]=hand
  self.move(q,N);return q
 def pic(self,name):

  for cam in ['front','side','top']:
   Image.fromarray(s.render(cam)).resize((960,720)).save('/app/output/'+name+'_'+cam+'.png')
 def report(self,name):

  print(name,'step',s.steps,'progress',s.progress(),'obj',d.xpos[s._obj], 'quat',d.xquat[s._obj],flush=True)

import base64, zlib, json

import rcb_dtb

PLAN = PAYLOAD

    for target in plan:

    assert replay['state_sha'] == expected_hash, (expected_hash, replay)
    second = s.replay(actions)
    assert second == replay
    print(json.dumps({'rows': len(actions), 'replay': replay}, indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
